description: This file defines the WorkerPoolImplementation class, which inherits from WPEFramework::Core::WorkerPool and WPEFramework::Core::ThreadPool::ICallback. It includes a nested Dispatcher class implementing WPEFramework::Core::ThreadPool::IDispatcher. The class manages a worker thread pool with specific configurations and lifecycle methods.

classes.name: WorkerPoolImplementation
classes.description: Implements a worker thread pool with a nested Dispatcher class for job dispatching, managing thread count, queue size, and lifecycle.

classes.name: Dispatcher
classes.description: Nested class implementing the IDispatcher interface to handle job dispatching within the thread pool.

methods.name: WorkerPoolImplementation
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the thread pool with specified stack size and starts it.

methods.name: ~WorkerPoolImplementation
methods.description: Destructor that stops the thread pool.
